Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Crimson-red HAIR — not an orange beard; a young king, not a bearded giant.
  • Red eyes; black horns, red-tipped.
  • Black kimono open on the chest, ORANGE+GOLD flame-and-cloud scrollwork — never a dragon; braided straw-rope obi hung with ofuda; gold ofuda-plaque earrings.
  • Sake gourd + dish; real warm orange flame. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
